purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer access outcomes, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review for Jijiga.
assessment: The official Jigjiga city portal is under maintenance. The official Somali Regional State bureau establishes a local/regional land-administration custodian and general registration mandate, while Ethiopia's e-Land and Ethio-NSDI establish national geospatial service routes. No anonymous Jijiga parcel feature response, safe native parcel ID, CRS, or full polygon was obtained. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was used.
